thesis: The page is a verdict seam: one 12-degree copper/teal fault line that every fact on the site must pick a side of, and that you can push with your own appliance's age.

signature.name: Verdict Seam + FIX/NEW tag
signature.summary: A 12-degree hard diagonal between a copper REPAIR field and a teal REPLACE field whose position is one CSS var --seam set by the hero calculator; a Martian Mono FIX / CALL / NEW tag marks which side each price, cause card and review lands on. Hero: calculator straddles the seam; age-line story slides the seam as years pass the typical lifespan; reviews lean to their side; footer flattens the seam to a level hairline.

layoutMoves: 12-degree seam splits whole bands into copper and teal fields; content placed by verdict side
wide Archivo verdict words at 125% stretch across the seam, narrow mono evidence columns
pinned age ruler with an appliance line drawing as centre column, seam sliding behind it

motion.intro: Seam draws corner to corner 500ms, copper and teal fields wipe in from opposite sides; h1 static and readable from frame 0.
stories: Age-line dial: age 0-15 scrubs under a pinned appliance outline, seam slides from repair toward replace past the typical lifespan, tag flips FIX-CALL-NEW
Review wipe: the seam wipes across the review band once and cards settle on their side
motion.hover: 12-degree slash underline grows scaleX from left, 200ms
